identities.identity_scope: Specific PBS blend with 45 wt.% softwood kraft lignin Indulin AT relative to total polymer mass; source B45 simple-blend series, not DCP-reactive R45. Section 2.3 describes separately extruded physical formulations, and Table 6 reports the separately measured B45 tensile result. The 45 wt.% lignin formulation differs from the existing B10, B20 and B30 compositions; processing states, test repeats and translated labels do not create additional identities. Broad composite category denotes lignin-filled polymer, not an engineered continuous-fiber laminate. Section 2.1 gives the unresolved combined designation BioPBS FZ91PM/FZ91PB; no single grade is selected or inferred. Bxx/Rxx are study formulation labels, not certified grades.

evidence.locator: PDF p.3 sections 2.1-2.3; p.12 Table 6 B45

processing.text: Source §2.3: separate 50 g formulations single-screw extruded at 140 °C into 3 mm strands and pelletized; portions compounded in Dynisco LMM at 100 rpm for 10 min at 140 °C, then injection-molded into dog-bone specimens.
processing.notes: Hot-pressed 120 °C discs are a separate preparation route. Acetone/DCP drying conditions belong to the reactive series and are not assigned to this simple blend.
